grain_rationale: The profile shows row_count=166158 and duplicate_row_rate=0.0, so each row is already a distinct flight event with no exact duplicates to absorb; grain_type is transaction, and the derived identity over flight_date, carrier_code, flight_number, and origin_airport identifies a single scheduled flight instance per row.

fields.name: flight_date
fields.description: Calendar date of the scheduled flight, ranging 2013-01-01 to 2013-06-30 across 181 distinct dates with no nulls, used as a dimension since departure_hour_utc is the designated time field.

fields.name: carrier_code
fields.description: Two-letter IATA carrier code (16 distinct values such as 9E, AA, DL, UA) identifying the operating airline, complete with no nulls.

fields.name: flight_number
fields.description: Airline-assigned flight number (1 to 8500, 2994 distinct values) that labels the flight instance rather than measuring a quantity, with no nulls.

fields.name: origin_airport
fields.description: Three-letter origin airport code, one of EWR, JFK, or LGA, complete with no nulls.

fields.name: sched_dep_hhmm
fields.description: Scheduled departure time encoded as HHMM (500 to 2359, 969 distinct values), a time label rather than a measure, with no nulls.

fields.name: dest_airport
fields.description: Three-letter destination airport code (100 distinct values such as ABQ, ATL, BNA), complete with no nulls.

fields.name: tail_number
fields.description: Aircraft tail number (3825 distinct values such as N0EGMQ) identifying the specific airframe; nullable at a 0.9154% rate where the registry could not be matched.

fields.name: is_cancelled
fields.description: Flag indicating whether the flight was cancelled (true/false), complete with no nulls.

fields.name: dep_hhmm
fields.description: Actual departure time encoded as HHMM (1 to 2400, 1291 distinct values); nullable at 2.9388% where the flight never departed and kept no actual time, per operator context.

fields.name: dep_delay_minutes
fields.description: Departure delay in minutes (-33 to 1301, negative when early), summable and comparable across flights; nullable at 2.9388% matching dep_hhmm's nulls for flights that never departed.

fields.name: arr_hhmm
fields.description: Actual arrival time encoded as HHMM (1 to 2400, 1392 distinct values); nullable at 3.07% for flights lacking an actual arrival.

fields.name: sched_arr_hhmm
fields.description: Scheduled arrival time encoded as HHMM (1 to 2359, 1134 distinct values), a time label, complete with no nulls.

fields.name: arr_delay_minutes
fields.description: Arrival delay in minutes (-86 to 1272, negative when early), a measure compared and summed across flights; nullable at 3.2981% for flights lacking an actual arrival.

fields.name: air_time_minutes
fields.description: Airborne duration in minutes (20 to 695), a measure averaged and summed across flights; nullable at 3.2981% matching arrival-time nulls.

fields.name: distance_miles
fields.description: Great-circle distance flown in miles (80 to 4983, 203 distinct values), a measure summed and averaged across flights, complete with no nulls.

fields.name: sched_dep_hour_local
fields.description: Scheduled departure hour in local time (5 to 23, 19 distinct values), a time-bucket label rather than a measure, complete with no nulls.

fields.name: sched_dep_minute_local
fields.description: Scheduled departure minute in local time (0 to 59, 60 distinct values), a time label, complete with no nulls.

fields.name: departure_hour_utc
fields.description: Actual departure timestamp in UTC, resolved to the hour (samples step by exactly one hour, e.g. 2013-01-01T10:00:00 to 11:00:00), the designated event time for this fact, complete with no nulls.

fields.name: carrier_name
fields.description: Full legal carrier name (16 distinct values such as Delta Air Lines Inc., United Air Lines Inc.) joined from the carrier lookup, complete with no nulls per the operator context.

fields.name: aircraft_manufacturer
fields.description: Aircraft manufacturer name (34 distinct values such as AIRBUS, BOEING) joined from the aircraft registry; nullable at 16.0426% where the registry join did not resolve, per operator context.

fields.name: aircraft_model
fields.description: Aircraft model (121 distinct values such as 172E, 550) joined from the aircraft registry; nullable at 16.0426% matching the manufacturer join gap.

fields.name: aircraft_manufacture_year
fields.description: Year the aircraft was manufactured (1956 to 2013, 46 distinct values), a label rather than a summed quantity; nullable at 17.6531% where the registry join did not resolve.

fields.name: aircraft_seat_count
fields.description: Seat capacity of the aircraft (2 to 450, 47 distinct values), a count that can be summed or averaged across flights; nullable at 16.0426% matching the aircraft registry join gap.

fields.name: aircraft_engine_type
fields.description: Aircraft engine type (6 distinct values such as Turbo-fan, Turbo-jet) joined from the aircraft registry; nullable at 16.0426% matching the registry join gap.

fields.name: origin_airport_name
fields.description: Full origin airport name (one of John F. Kennedy International Airport, LaGuardia Airport, Newark Liberty International Airport), complete with no nulls per the operator context noting origin is complete.

fields.name: origin_municipality
fields.description: Origin municipality, either New York or Newark, complete with no nulls.

fields.name: origin_elevation_ft
fields.description: Origin airport elevation in feet (13, 18, or 21), a static airport attribute label rather than a flight measure, complete with no nulls.

fields.name: origin_longest_runway_ft
fields.description: Origin airport's longest runway length in feet (7002, 11000, or 14511), a static airport attribute label, complete with no nulls.

fields.name: dest_airport_name
fields.description: Full destination airport name (99 distinct values such as Albany International Airport) joined from OurAirports; nullable at 2.089% where the destination join did not resolve, per operator context.

fields.name: dest_municipality
fields.description: Destination municipality (95 distinct values such as Albuquerque, Atlanta) joined from OurAirports; nullable at 2.089% matching the destination join gap.

fields.name: dest_iso_region
fields.description: Destination ISO region code (45 distinct values such as US-CA, US-FL, PR-U-A) joined from OurAirports; nullable at 2.089% matching the destination join gap.

fields.name: dest_elevation_ft
fields.description: Destination airport elevation in feet (3 to 6606), a static airport attribute label; nullable at 2.089% matching the destination join gap.

fields.name: dest_longest_runway_ft
fields.description: Destination airport's longest runway length in feet (5076 to 16000), a static airport attribute label; nullable at 2.089% matching the destination join gap.

fields.name: captured_at
fields.description: Profiling capture timestamp (16 distinct values clustered within one minute on 2026-09-02), an ingestion-time marker rather than the flight's business time, complete with no nulls.

category_description: One row represents a single scheduled commercial flight departing from a New York area airport (EWR, JFK, or LGA) in 2013, carrying its carrier, aircraft, schedule, actual times, delays, and origin/destination airport attributes as joined in the silver contract.
purpose: This mapping declares how the silver_flights table enters the gold unified event star as the flights fact category, for the deterministic modeling engine that renders the gold models from this contract.
usage: The mapping contract is rendered to an ODCS mapping contract draft, validated by the frozen mapping-contract schema and datacontract lint, and reviewed by a human before approval; once approved, the modeling engine consumes it to emit gold fact and dimension models at hour grain keyed on departure_hour_utc.
limitations: The mapping does not resolve the aircraft registry gaps (aircraft_manufacturer, aircraft_model, aircraft_manufacture_year, aircraft_seat_count, aircraft_engine_type all null at 16.0426%-17.6531%) or the destination join gaps (dest_airport_name, dest_municipality, dest_iso_region, dest_elevation_ft, dest_longest_runway_ft all null at 2.089%) into defaults, does not exclude cancelled flights (is_cancelled) or flights that never departed (dep_hhmm, dep_delay_minutes, arr_hhmm, arr_delay_minutes, air_time_minutes null at 2.9388%-3.2981%), and performs no transformation beyond the flight_identity derived from flight_date, carrier_code, flight_number, and origin_airport; consumers decide how to treat these nulls and cancellations.
